rationale: Human Owner explicitly requested that the final Thematic cover practical reception, deployment experience, independent reproduction, actual runtime behavior, and reported failures/trade-offs in addition to origin papers, mechanisms, adopted models and benchmark results. After Sol technical Discovery completeness PASS (161 records), Sol changes the Thematic X policy decision from NOT_REQUIRED to REQUIRED for one bounded reception/deployment pass (efficient-llm-reception-pass-01). X/community is reception-only authority, never technical-spec/sole-benchmark/sole-release-license authority; every technical claim promoted later returns to primary/independent authority. This does not invalidate the Sol technical Discovery completeness PASS.
